page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor configured with 52 physical cores and 52 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage for data persistence. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, offering predictable performance for workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is designed for memory-intensive and caching applications such as Redis, in-memory databases, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon compute resources and a 12 Gbps network interface.
